source_sidecar.readme:
Slint LSP 1.18.1 source sidecar

The independently executed Odin build redistributes the official slint-lsp Windows x64
binary as a separate process under the GPL-3.0-only choice. Odin itself is not linked
to the Slint runtime. This source inventory is supplied alongside the binary.

Main source commit: 372cf0ee5577c3dfec309a45e7b778ba4e81b734 (v1.18.1)
The upstream tarball contains LICENSES/GPL-3.0-only.txt, all Slint source, Cargo.lock,
and .github/workflows/slint_tool_binary.yaml / scripts/prepare_binary_package.sh.
All 993 registry crate archives match the included Cargo.lock package checksums.
The upstream rust-skia/skia m153-0.101.2 source archive is also included.
Each unmodified compressed source has an exact URL and SHA256 in source-index.json.

Rebuild guidance (NOT_RUN; not a reproduced-release claim):
1. Extract the Slint archive and crate archives into separate source/vendor directories.
   Preserve each crate name-version directory; generate Cargo vendor .cargo-checksum.json
   files using the package SHA256 from Cargo.lock and SHA256 for every extracted file.
2. Configure [source.crates-io] replace-with='vendored-sources' and
   [source.vendored-sources] directory pointing to the vendor directory.
3. Use the Rust stable MSVC toolchain and Windows C/C++ SDK described in the included
   upstream .github/actions/setup-rust/action.yml and release workflow.
4. Upstream workflow build command for the LSP is:
   cargo build --verbose --no-default-features --features
   backend-linuxkms-libinput,backend-winit,renderer-femtovg,renderer-skia,renderer-software
   --release -p slint-lsp
   Upstream sets CARGO_PROFILE_RELEASE_LTO=fat and CODEGEN_UNITS=1.
   Use --locked. An offline rebuild also requires resolving the native DEPS below.
5. Extract the Skia archive into the skia-bindings crate skia/ directory. The 14
   literal repository references in Skia DEPS are included under skia-native/; unpack
   each into its source-index path. libpng is the same exact commit from the official
   pnggroup GitHub repository because the Skia Gitiles archive returned HTTP503.
   Compiler, Windows SDK, Python, GN, Ninja and other build tools are prerequisites.
   Use the included upstream build support and recipe to configure a from-source
   build. Exact release feature inputs/tool versions and code-signing remain unverified.
